work.text: Although a very versatile painter, Ma is known today primarily for his landscape scrolls.

… he was probably the first of the Ma who excelled in monochrome ink-painting and sought his motives in nature. His son was Ma Hsing-tzu, who followed in the footsteps of the father, specializing likewise in birds and animals.

moment.text: From these it seems clear that Bayen's style goes back to Kiso Kotei, and so remotely to Ririomin. Or rather we may say that he relates more to Ririomin in figures, but more to Kiso in landscape.
moment.lead: Ernest Fenollosa, using Japanese readings: Bayen is Ma Yuan, Kiso Kotei the painter-emperor Huizong, Ririomin the painter Li Gonglin:

source.author: Ernest F. Fenollosa

matters.text: The bamboo, like a great lady, has a gentler character that will be found stronger when it comes to emergencies.
